description: This is a Bash script that automates running the static analysis tool cppcheck on a project's source code. It sets up include paths, executes cppcheck with specific options, and processes the output to categorize issues by severity.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: run_cppcheck
methods.description: Configures and runs the cppcheck static analysis on specified sources.

methods.name: colorize_severity
methods.description: Outputs messages with color coding based on severity level.

methods.name: output_results
methods.description: Analyzes the cppcheck output and reports the number of issues per severity, setting an exit code accordingly.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that checks prerequisites and runs analysis.
